full_judgment: 2. At the heart of the dispute is a piece ofland comprising .98 acres of Government's khas land on plot Nos. 1200, and 1202 in Mouja, Sub-Registry and District Barguna, hereinafter referred to as the suit land. On it a District Board-managed thana level 'Charitable Dispensary' was established. It was prior to 1949; Barguna was then only a thana within the greater District of Barisal. On 1-10-1949 the said 'Charitable Dispensary' was transferred to the Health Department of the Government. In 1974 it was converted into a 30-bed Hospital. In 1981 the Hospital was shifted to its present site. Since then part of the suit land was being used as the Office of the Civil Surgeon, until the latter was moved to a new site in 1987. The other part of the suit land was being used to provide residential accommodation to the Medical Officer and the Pharmacist of the Hospital. Presently, the Immunisation Programme of the Department of Health is being carried out on the suit land. Also, it provides residential accommodation to some of the employees of the Department of Health.
